title: Layerwise Learning-Rate Scaling in Vision Networks: Effective-Rate Identification, Power-Mean Aggregation, and Budget Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2611.21696v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Layerwise learning-rate scaling assigns different learning rates to different parts of a network. Although established in fine-tuning pretrained models, its effects in vision networks trained from scratch are commonly assessed by training each candidate recipe. We show that, in this setting, the rate-related component of a layerwise strategy is well summarized by an effective learning rate computable directly from its multiplier profile. Across matched-control comparisons, changes in test accuracy closely track changes in training loss (r = -0.996), which supports an optimization-progress explanation of the short-budget rate effect. translated_title: 视觉网络中的逐层学习率缩放：有效学习率的识别、幂均值聚合与预算依赖性
translated_abstract: 逐层学习率缩放为网络的不同部分分配不同的学习率。尽管这一方法在微调预训练模型中已被确立，但其在从零开始训练的视觉网络中的效果通常需要通过训练每一个候选方案来评估。我们证明，在这种设置下，逐层策略中与学习率相关的部分可以很好地由一个有效学习率来概括，该有效学习率可以直接从其乘数配置中计算得出。在匹配对照的比较中，测试准确率的变化与训练损失的变化紧密相关（r = -0.996），这为短预算下学习率效应的“优化进展”解释提供了支持。将未调优的基础学习率提高十倍，会使学习率匹配的对比结果在所有六种测试架构中上移（p = 0.016），并将一种已发表的判别性调度方案（未纳入模型拟合）优于统一对照的架构数量从六种中的两种增加到五种中的五种（p…
tldr: 该论文发现从零训练视觉网络时，逐层学习率策略的效果可以由一个直接从乘数配置计算出的有效学习率来概括，短预算下的学习率效应主要源于优化进展，且对基础学习率的大小高度敏感。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that for vision networks trained from scratch, the rate-related effect of layerwise learning-rate scaling is well summarized by an effective learning rate computable directly from the multiplier profile, with short-budget effects driven by optimization progress and highly dependent on the base learning rate.
